设计意图： Mutation: ablation of volume confirmation modifier from parent factor. The parent's volume ratio weighted drawdown depth may introduce noise; removing it focuses on the core drawdown/vol signal which was the strength of the grandparent lineage. Preserves 21-day lookbacks and cs_rank to maintain rank stability (parent strength). Targets improving IC and ICIR by simplifying.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

(21-day high - close) / 21-day high / 21-day close std
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

(21-day high - close) / 21-day high / 21-day close std
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ts_max(high) → 窗口 21 的滚动最大值 (与m_max相同)
  2. 步骤2：subtract(v1(ts_max), close) → 减法：x - y
  3. 步骤3：ts_max(high) → 窗口 21 的滚动最大值 (与m_max相同)
  4. 步骤4：divide(v2(subtract), v3(ts_max)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  5. 步骤5：ts_std(close) → 窗口 21 的滚动标准差 (ts_std_dev的别名)
  6. 步骤6：divide(v4(divide), v5(ts_std)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high_21：high.滚动窗口(21, min_periods=21).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(high_21 - close) / high_21
  3. 计算 vol_std：close.滚动窗口(21, min_periods=21).std(ddof=1)
  4. 计算 factor：drawdown / vol_std
  5. 计算 factor：factor
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_vol_norm_clean(df): df_copy = df.copy() high_21 = df_copy["str">'high'].rolling(21, min_periods=21).max() drawdown = (high_21 - df_copy["str">'close']) / high_21.replace(0, np.nan) vol_std = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(21, min_periods=21).std(ddof=1).replace(0, np.nan) factor = drawdown / vol_std factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) factor.name = "str">'factor_drawdown_vol_norm_clean' "kw">class="kw">return factor
